list.query: SELECT CONCAT(location, ' - ', machine_name) AS __text, id AS __value FROM dbo.devices WHERE customer = 'PEPKOR' ORDER BY location, machine_name

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 1 status AS [Status]
FROM dbo.device_status
WHERE device_id = ${device}
ORDER BY ts_datetime DESC

SELECT TOP 1 COALESCE(CAST(application_running AS int), -1) AS [App Running]
FROM dbo.device_application_status
WHERE device_id = ${device}
ORDER BY ts_datetime DESC

SELECT TOP 1 CAST(cpu_percent AS decimal(5,1)) AS [CPU %]
FROM dbo.device_os_metrics WHERE device_id = ${device} ORDER BY ts_datetime DESC

SELECT TOP 1 CAST(mem_usage_pct AS decimal(5,1)) AS [Mem %]
FROM dbo.device_os_metrics WHERE device_id = ${device} ORDER BY ts_datetime DESC

SELECT TOP 1 CAST(temp_celsius AS decimal(5,1)) AS [Temp C]
FROM dbo.device_os_metrics WHERE device_id = ${device} ORDER BY ts_datetime DESC

SELECT TOP 1 uptime_seconds AS [Uptime]
FROM dbo.device_uptime_status WHERE device_id = ${device} ORDER BY ts_datetime DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_items),0) AS [Items Today]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${device}
AND CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 2, ts_datetime) AS date) = CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 2, GETDATE()) AS date)

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(100.0*SUM(good_read)/NULLIF(SUM(total_items),0),0) AS decimal(5,1)) AS [Good Read %]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${device}
AND CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 2, ts_datetime) AS date) = CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 2, GETDATE()) AS date)

SELECT ts_datetime AS time, total_items AS [Total Items], good_read AS [Good Reads], no_read AS [No Reads]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${device}
AND $__timeFilter(ts_datetime)
ORDER BY ts_datetime

SELECT ts_datetime AS time,
  CAST(CASE WHEN total_items > 0 THEN 100.0*good_read/total_items ELSE NULL END AS decimal(6,2)) AS [Good Read %]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${device}
AND $__timeFilter(ts_datetime)
ORDER BY ts_datetime

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(100.0*SUM(no_dimension)/NULLIF(SUM(total_items),0),0) AS decimal(5,1)) AS [No Dims %]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${device} AND $__timeFilter(ts_datetime)

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(100.0*SUM(item_out_of_spec)/NULLIF(SUM(total_items),0),0) AS decimal(5,1)) AS [Out of Spec %]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${device} AND $__timeFilter(ts_datetime)

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(100.0*SUM(more_than_1_item)/NULLIF(SUM(total_items),0),0) AS decimal(5,1)) AS [Multiple Items %]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${device} AND $__timeFilter(ts_datetime)

SELECT x.drive AS [Drive], x.total_gb AS [Total GB], x.used_gb AS [Used GB], x.free_gb AS [Free GB], CAST(x.usage_percent AS decimal(5,1)) AS [Used %]
FROM (
  SELECT drive, total_gb, free_gb, used_gb, usage_percent,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY drive ORDER BY ts_datetime DESC) AS rn
  FROM dbo.device_storage_status
  WHERE device_id = ${device}
) x WHERE x.rn = 1
ORDER BY x.drive

FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${device}
AND $__timeFilter(ts_datetime)

panels.title: Hourly Items — Today vs Daily Average

targets.rawSql:
WITH
hours AS (
    SELECT 0 AS hr UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3
    UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7
    UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11
    UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
    UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19
    UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23
),
monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ds.hr,
        CAST(AVG(CAST(ds.day_total AS float)) AS decimal(10,1)) AS avg_items
    FROM (
        SELECT
            DATEPART(HOUR, DATEADD(HOUR, 2, ts_datetime)) AS hr,
            CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 2, ts_datetime) AS date) AS day_date,
            SUM(total_items) AS day_total
        FROM dbo.device_statistics
        WHERE device_id = ${device}
          AND CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 2, ts_datetime) AS date) >=
              CAST(DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(DATEADD(HOUR,2,GETDATE())), MONTH(DATEADD(HOUR,2,GETDATE())), 1) AS date)
          AND CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 2, ts_datetime) AS date) < CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 2, GETDATE()) AS date)
        GROUP BY
            DATEPART(HOUR, DATEADD(HOUR, 2, ts_datetime)),
            CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 2, ts_datetime) AS date)
    ) ds
    GROUP BY ds.hr
),
today_actuals AS (
    SELECT
        DATEPART(HOUR, DATEADD(HOUR, 2, ts_datetime)) AS hr,
        SUM(total_items) AS actual_items
    FROM dbo.device_statistics
    WHERE device_id = ${device}
      AND CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 2, ts_datetime) AS date) = CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 2, GETDATE()) AS date)
      AND DATEPART(HOUR, DATEADD(HOUR, 2, ts_datetime)) < DATEPART(HOUR, DATEADD(HOUR, 2, GETDATE()))
    GROUP BY DATEPART(HOUR, DATEADD(HOUR, 2, ts_datetime))
)
SELECT
    RIGHT('0' + CAST(h.hr AS varchar), 2) + ':00' AS hour_label,
    COALESCE(m.avg_items, 0)  AS [Avg Items],
    t.actual_items            AS [Actual Items]
FROM hours h
LEFT JOIN monthly_avg   m ON m.hr = h.hr
LEFT JOIN today_actuals t ON t.hr = h.hr
ORDER BY h.hr

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(100.0*SUM(no_weight)/NULLIF(SUM(total_items),0),0) AS decimal(5,1)) AS [No Weight %]
FROM dbo.device_statistics
WHERE device_id = ${device} AND $__timeFilter(ts_datetime)
